The goal of GitDay_Finse is to make a little GitHub repo


For this repo, I made a little histogram:
```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

lil_hist <- ggplot(data = mtcars) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x=mpg)) +
  theme_bw()
```

Look at it here!
